lines.beaver_en: Who would you recommend for this project?
lines.learner: 박서준 대리를 추천합니다. 아주 착실한 사람입니다.
lines.en: I recommend Assistant Manager Park Seojun. He's very steady.
lines.roman: Bak Seojun daerireul chucheonhamnida. aju chaksilhan saramimnida.

lines.beaver_en: What's your first impression of him?
lines.learner: 처음엔 수줍어 보이지만 언행에 품위가 있습니다.
lines.en: He seems shy at first, but his words and deeds have class.
lines.roman: cheoeumen sujubeo boijiman eonhaenge pumwiga itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: How is his attitude toward work?
lines.en: He's diligent and meticulous, so he rarely makes mistakes.

lines.beaver_en: Meticulous, then. What is his personality like?
lines.en: He's gentle outside, strong inside. Soft on the surface, but tough within.

lines.beaver_en: How is he under heavy pressure?
lines.en: Even in a crisis, he handles things calmly and maturely.

lines.beaver_en: What is he like in front of superiors?
lines.en: He's upright, so he never acts servile or cowardly.
If he has a flaw, it's that he's a little impatient.

lines.beaver_en: Isn't it easy to ruin work when you're impatient?
lines.learner: 네, 서두르면 실수하기 십상이라 늘 조심합니다.
lines.en: Yes, rushing is likely to cause mistakes, so he's always careful.
lines.roman: ne, seodureumyeon silsuhagi sipsangira neul josimhamnida.

lines.beaver_en: Does he get along well with colleagues?
lines.en: He's funny and frank, so he's very popular.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Then I'll go with Mr. Park.
lines.learner: 감사합니다. 성실하고 겸허해서 잘 해낼 겁니다.
lines.en: Thank you. He's sincere and humble, so he'll do well.
lines.roman: gamsahamnida. seongsilhago gyeomheohaeseo jal haenael geomnida.
